integrity_notes: Finite exhaustive checks cover bounded parameters only; the all-integer theorem is proved analytically.
The source expected-decrease formula, cost model, and two-core tie were already published; only the complete proof and all-parameter classification are claimed.
scientific_limitations: The optimized quantity is the source paper's expected descent on a linearized objective under Haar subspaces, divided by an idealized synchronous evaluation-round count.
No runtime, nonlinear convergence, or communication-latency optimality is claimed.
The final publisher-hosted journal text was identified but not directly accessible; later full-text equivalences remain a priority risk.
title: An all-core optimum for parallel Haar-subspace simplex gradients
